name: folate receptor alpha

function.text: FOLR1 encodes folate receptor alpha. Annotated molecular activities include signaling receptor activity and folic acid receptor activity. It participates in axon regeneration and heart looping.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to neurodegenerative syndrome due to cerebral folate transport deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: The gene appears in specialty educational coverage, but a disease-specific somatic driver relationship has not been assigned in this draft; expression-marker or assay-context mentions are not mutation evidence.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
